  r.append([np.nanmedian(p[:, 0]), np.nanmedian(s[:, 0]), np.nanmedian(np.r_[s[:, 1], s[:, 2]]), np.nanstd(s[:, 0]), np.median(g[y1 - 60:y1, list(sx)])])
  var = nanvar(a, axis=axis, dtype=dtype, out=out, ddof=ddof,
